name: paddock
description: A local desktop home for agent sessions, usage and API calls.

scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/smoke.cjs && node scripts/workbench-smoke.cjs && node scripts/layout-smoke.cjs && node scripts/setup-smoke.cjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --dir --win --x64
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/checksum.cjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never && node scripts/checksum.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && PADDOCK_ARCH=arm64 npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && PADDOCK_ARCH=x64 npm run prepare:runtime && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never && node scripts/checksum.cjs
scripts.test:linux: docker build -q -f scripts/linux/Dockerfile -t paddock-linux . && docker run --rm --shm-size=1g paddock-linux

author: YeerooXY
